utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I think I left my good intentions in the shed along with that broken handle. What are you bringing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've got an old toolbox I'm gonna dig through—hoping to find some useful bits and bobs for Cleo's collection.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A toolbox, you say? That reminds me—I think I have one somewhere too, but I can't remember if it's full of tools or just rusty memories.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I'm glad you're here—I'm organizing a repair drive for the community center. Got any spare parts or tools you could donate?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? I think I heard something about that... Wait, is that the fix-it day this Saturday? I might have an old hammer I could dig up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that's the one! Even a hammer would be great—every little bit helps us get the repair bench fully stocked.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got everything ready for Saturday morning. Just let me know where to drop the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Leo! We're meeting at my garage at 8 AM; you can drop your tools off there or bring them to the Smiths' fence first thing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 8 AM at your garage works. I'll be there with the hammers and saws.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I was gonna bring my tool kit and that stack of scrap wood I've been saving. Figure we might need some spare parts for whatever folks bring in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's perfect, Sam! Having spare wood and tools will be a huge help—I'll add that to the supply list Rosa and I are putting together tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did the repair drive actually come through? I need you to confirm because I've heard promises before.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's definitely happening this weekend! Opal's got everything organized, and I've already offered my power drill and socket set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but I've heard that before too. You're sure you're not just stalling?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and I think they're also doing a workshop on basic fixes after the drive—you could learn to fix that blender yourself next time!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A workshop, you say? Now that's exactly what I like to see — a plan with follow-through. I'll stick around for that if it's on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I heard it's right after the repair drive ends, so you won't have to wait long.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, I'm heading to the community center Saturday for that repair drive—heard you might be interested too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I'll be there! It's at the community center on Oak Street from 10 to 4. I've been mapping out who's bringing what tools—do you have any to lend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I've got a wrench set and a multimeter I can bring. Happy to help out!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hello Bo, I heard about the repair drive. I'll be there if I can, but I'm not sure how much help I'll be.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Uli, no worries—any help is good help. I still need to actually sign up myself, if I can ever find that flyer.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Leo has a spare flyer, he's been really organized about all this.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, once Hana confirms what's in the shed, we can match up what Leo's bringing and fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my old blender too, if that helps fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, a blender! That could actually come in handy for the teachers' lounge—I'll add it to the list right after we sort out the basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing my old blender, and I think Marlon's bringing his broken toaster. It's at the community center from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm so excited! I've been coordinating with Mara to get all the supplies ready. It's going to be a great day!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's wonderful, Rosa! I heard Sarah's bringing her sewing machine too—I'll let Mike know about that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs to be repaired?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, a bit of everything! Folks are bringing in old lamps, creaky chairs, a toaster that's been acting up — you name it, we're fixing it on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds like a busy day. Do you have a list of what's coming, or are we figuring it out as we go?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure we have a solid list before Quinn starts spreading the word—can we double-check the sign-ups one more time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, Pia, I can help double-check. Just fill me in on who's signed up so far.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, let me pull up the list—I've got Mrs. Chen, the Rodriguez family, and the new folks on Elm Street, but I want to make sure I haven't missed anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you know what time the repair drive starts on Saturday, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Starts at 9 AM sharp, but I’m planning to get there early to set up the tools table—have we agreed on who’s bringing what yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure about the tools, but I can bring my old blender for repair.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We're kicking things off at 8 sharp on Saturday morning, Rey. Come by if you need anything fixed or just want to borrow a tool.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did the repair drive actually come through? I need you to confirm because I've heard promises before.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's definitely happening this Saturday, Kira. I've already got my tools gathered and the Smiths' fence is our first stop, so it's all set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great! I'll probably see you there then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a plan! I'll bring my drill and socket set—see you at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect! I'll bring some snacks for us while we work. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head to the shed now to check on the repair drive—should only take a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, before you go, make sure to grab the extension cords—Mike was asking about them for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good thinking, Vik—I’ll grab those cords while I’m at the shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs to be repaired?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, all sorts of things! Vik's bringing an old blender, Marlon's got a broken toaster—I'm sure lots of us have stuff needing a fix.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds like a busy day. Do you have a checklist or are we just going to take things as they come?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I've got that squeaky gate... I really should fix that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, no worries about that squeaky gate. If you've got some WD-40, we can take a quick look at it after the Smiths' fence.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, WD-40, right! I think I have a can somewhere... in the garage? Maybe. I'll dig it out before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for checking, Hana! Once you confirm, I'll update the list and we can figure out a time that works around school pick-ups.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Faye, I'm heading out to spread the word door-to-door tomorrow—want me to swing by your place first so we can coordinate the setup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be perfect, Quinn! Let's meet around 9—right after I drop the kids off, and we can map out which houses to hit first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I'm gathering supplies and could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, hi Mara. Yeah, I'll be there... though I'm not sure I'm much good with tools, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't worry about skills—any help is welcome, even just handing things out or organizing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Have you got a plan for the repair drive, Sam? I like to know what's happening and when.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm going to inspect it first thing to know exactly what we're dealing with, then I'll lay out a plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that sounds sensible. Let me know when you've got the details—I'll clear my calendar for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Leo, did you hear about Cleo's repair drive? I offered to dig out my old toolbox for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard. Got my hammers and saws ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear you're pitching in too—I'm hoping we can really stock that bench up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa! I'd like to know where and when the repair drive will be held so I can mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure! It'll be this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center down on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to sort out what I can bring, but I always forget. What about you, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: You know, I saw the flyer ages ago but I still haven't signed up—I'll get it together this week, I swear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Well, if you see me wandering around with a broken chair, you'll know I finally remembered too!

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
